Thank you, Sol. I can now see four roots at (11.21,17.58), and will collect them, eat some and keep a reserve. Your directions helped. I would like to keep sharing food locations with you.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.

execution.progress: start or resume continues with the same action, one step per round, until it completes or stops; a round taken by another action pauses it. Steps and costs stay.

details.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
details.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: tell
value.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
value.costs: One round; no energy or material.
value.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

value.name: Reciprocal conversation
value.function: A two-person conversation session over ordinary tell: propose it to someone you see within 5, each of you joins, then speak with contribute, optionally answering a heard utterance of the other.
value.costs: propose, join, resume, contribute: tell's cost, 1 round, 0 energy, 0 material. pause, leave, cancel: no energy, no speech; they only use your action. Study: 1 round; needs tell.
value.effects: propose: participants [you, them], topic (max 80), rounds 1-20 until expiry; says an invitation with the session id; only someone who hears it can join. join (with session and topic, the proposer too) and resume say a short tell; contribute says text (max 240) as tell; optional respondsTo: a heard utterance id of theirs in it. Each needs them alive within 5; words count only if they heard them. Active once both joined and heard each other. An answer with new words to their earlier utterance records a reciprocal exchange. Another action (wait is silence), urgent risk or more than 5 apart pauses it; both must resume. leave, cancel, death or expiry ends it. Your record shows only your acts, what you heard and changes within 5 of you. Grants nothing; no reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one complete action; a session spans rounds through separate actions of both people.
